<jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
                     </jats:title><jats:p>Exact field theory dualities can be implemented by duality domain walls such that passing any operator through the interface maps it to the dual operator. This paper describes the S-duality wall of four-dimensional <jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ \mathcal{N} $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mi>N</mml:mi>
                </mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula> = 2 SU(<jats:italic>N</jats:italic>) SQCD with 2<jats:italic>N</jats:italic> hypermultiplets in terms of fields on the defect, namely three-dimensional <jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ \mathcal{N} $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mi>N</mml:mi>
                </mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula> = 2 SQCD with gauge group U(<jats:italic>N −</jats:italic> 1) and 2<jats:italic>N</jats:italic> flavours, with a monopole superpotential. The theory is self-dual under a duality found by Benini, Benvenuti and Pasquetti, in the same way that <jats:italic>T</jats:italic>[SU(<jats:italic>N</jats:italic>)] (the S-duality wall of <jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ \mathcal{N} $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mi>N</mml:mi>
                </mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula> = 4 super Yang-Mills) is self-mirror. The domain-wall theory can also be realized as a limit of a USp(2<jats:italic>N −</jats:italic> 2) gauge theory; it reduces to known results for <jats:italic>N</jats:italic> = 2. The theory is found through the AGT correspondence by determining the braiding kernel of two semi-degenerate vertex operators in Toda CFT.</jats:p>
title: S-duality wall of SQCD from Toda braiding
